_doc: Phase 6 plan 06-03 report_slices expected digest (REFACTOR phase). EXPECTED_REPORT_DIGEST is the canonical sha256 of the UncertaintyReport built from input.json with experiment_id='0'*64, built_at_utc=2026-09-26T12:00:00Z, bootstrap_seed=42, resamples=10000, probable=0.1, universe_tags as in input.json. The refactor replaced statistics.mean/median/pstdev (float-returning) with Decimal-only helpers, so the digest changed. Per D-04, the digest pins every section so any undeclared semantic change fails the acceptance gate.
